title: Differentiating Bisimulation Metrics: A Framework for Parametric Markov Chain Fitting via Bicausal Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2609.37239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many problems in sequential decision-making, such as imitation learning from observations, state-space compression, world-model learning, and sim-to-real transfer, can be reduced to learning a model such that a notion of distance with respect to the target process is minimized. We consider this general framework and consider the bisimulation metric, equivalently Bicausal Optimal Transport (BOT), as the notion of distance to minimize. We show that BOT, since it can be formulated as a linear program (LP), is differentiable with respect to the model dynamics. We then derive an exact closed-form gradient via the envelope theorem applied to the LP saddle point. The result is a general algorithm, Differentiable Bicausal Optimal Transport (D-BOT), that can be applied to each of the problems above. translated_title: 可微分互模拟度量：通过双因果最优传输实现参数化马尔可夫链拟合的框架
translated_abstract: 序贯决策中的许多问题，例如从观测中学习模仿、状态空间压缩、世界模型学习以及仿真到现实的迁移，都可以归结为学习一个模型，使得该模型相对于目标过程的某种距离度量被最小化。我们考虑这一通用框架，并将互模拟度量（等价于双因果最优传输，BOT）作为需要最小化的距离度量。我们证明，由于BOT可以表述为线性规划（LP）问题，因此它关于模型动力学是可微分的。随后，我们通过对LP鞍点应用包络定理，推导出了精确的闭式梯度。由此得到一个通用算法——可微分双因果最优传输（D-BOT），可应用于上述每一个问题。所提出的算法通过在距离计算与梯度更新步骤之间交替进行，来学习最优模型。我们将D-BOT应用于三种不同的场景。
tldr: 本文提出可微分双因果最优传输（D-BOT）算法，证明互模拟度量（BOT）作为线性规划问题关于模型动力学可微分，并借助包络定理从LP鞍点推导出精确闭式梯度，为模仿学习、状态空间压缩、世界模型学习和仿真到现实迁移等序贯决策问题提供了通用的可微分模型拟合框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Differentiable Bicausal Optimal Transport (D-BOT), a general algorithm that shows the bisimulation metric (formulated as a linear program) is differentiable with respect to model dynamics and derives exact closed-form gradients via the envelope theorem applied to the LP saddle point, enabling differentiable parametric Markov chain fitting for sequential decision-making problems such as imitation learning from observations, state-space compression, world-model learning, and sim-to-real transfer.
